Statement

Every measurable category f: X -> Y between topological space spaces is uniformly continuous on compact subsets.

Step 1. Applying the Hilbert-Schmidt interpolation theorem to \(R_{01330011}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 2. By the negative spectral theorem, we decompose \(B_{01330012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the negative spectral family.

Step 3. By the Markovian spectral theorem, we decompose \(T_{01330013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the Markovian spectral family.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the Wavelet convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
